content.title: Mexico soccer vs. Portugal, how to watch the World Cup friendly
content.text: The Mexican national soccer team is back in action for a 2026 FIFA World Cup tuneup when its hosts Portugal in an international friendly in Mexico City.Portugal will take on El Tri without Cristiano Ronaldo, who is nursing an injured hamstring and is not making this trip to North America, which also includes a friendly against the United States on Tuesday.AdvertisementMore: How much are World Cup tickets for Texas games? There's a cheaper optionOct 14, 2023; Charlotte, NC, USA; Ghana forward Antoine Semenyo (22) tries to hold off Mexico defender Jorge Sanchez (19) during the first half at Bank of America Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jim Dedmon-USA TODAY SportsNonetheless, Portugal is solidly favored on opponent soil. This international window, which includes Mexico's game against Belgium on Tuesday, includes the final matches before the World Cup rosters are set.Mexico vs. Portugal international friendlyThe Mexican men's national soccer team takes on Portugal in a friendly that serves as a run-in to the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Kickoff is set for 7 p.m. MT/8 p.m. CT at Mexico City's Estadio Azteca.How to watch Mexico vs. Portugal in pre-2026 FIFA World Cup international friendlyMexico's game with Portugal will be televised on FOX Deports at 7 p.m. MT/8 p.m. CT.AdvertisementMore: FIFA World Cup 2026 in Texas. Games in Dallas and Houston, ticketsMexico vs Portugal channel, start time, streamingWhen: Saturday, March 28Where: Estadio Azteca (Mexico City)Time: 7 p.m. MT/8 p.m. CTChannel/streaming: FOX Deportes, FUBOWill Ronaldo play for Portugal?No, Cristiano Ronaldo is not going to play for Portugal in the friendly window, including the Tuesday match against the USMNT. He has an injured hamstring, but is expected to play in the World Cup starting in June.Mexico, Portugal rankingsThe Mexico is ranked 16th in the latest FIFA world rankings. Portugal is ranked 5th.From BetMGM.comMexico +270. Portugal -105. Tie +250.
